Look, we all know why we’re here. It’s September/October, the itch kicks in, and we drop $70 (or more) on what is essentially an expensive squad update.I’ve played every entry since the old FIFA days, and after putting solid hours into FC 26, here is the honest truth: it’s easily the best version of the game since the name change, but it’s still fundamentally burdened by the same classic EA baggage.

The Good (The Pros):The "Authentic" Gameplay Preset is a genuine game-changer: If you play offline, Career Mode, or Kick-Off, the new Authentic physics mode actually makes football feel like football instead of an arcade pinball simulator. Players have actual inertia, passes require setup, and stamina matters.  Goalkeepers finally got an overhaul: Netminders don't parry every single save directly onto the striker's boots anymore. Rebounds feel organic, and 1v1 animations are much cleaner.  Career Mode & Archetypes: The additions to Player Career (Archetypes) and Manager Live events finally make single-player feel somewhat rewarding instead of an abandoned afterthought.Visually gorgeous: The player likenesses, crowd dynamics, and pitch degradation look unreal on high-end PC setups.

The Bad (The Flaws):Ultimate Team is still a casino: The monetization in FUT remains aggressively targeted at getting you to buy points. The dynamic difficulty/momentum ("DDA") feeling is still alive and well during Weekend League matches.  Competitive/Online gameplay is still hyper-speed chaos: If you step into Ultimate Team, all the nice "Authentic" simulation changes disappear. It quickly devolves back into pace-abuse, spinning in circles at the edge of the box, and spammed skill moves.Classic EA Menus & Server Lag: The UI is still inexplicably laggy on a high-spec PC. Mid-game micro-stutters and sudden server disconnects will steal winnable games from you.

The Verdict:If you buy this exclusively for Career Mode, Pro Clubs, or local kickoff with mates, FC 26 is actually a massive step forward and easily worth it on a sale.If you are buying this solely to sweat Ultimate Team and hope for a completely fair, lag-free competitive experience, you will end up wanting to throw your controller out the window within two weeks.Buy it if you love football, but wait for the first 30% discount if you're on the fence.

Positives - Maybe the most realistic Fifa gameplay ever and I'd be lying if I said I haven't enjoyed myself at all. HOWEVER, that does not detract from the ridiculous number of problems the game has that - for a studio with the revenue that EA generate - are unforgiveable in my opinion, especially after a full year's lifecycle. Some issues appear in previous iterations so really shouldn't be present, but don't worry, EA never fail to innovate and have also come up with a whole host of new problems that also shouldn't be present. Here's a list of my findings and opinions, having played most titles since 2009:

+Performance - the game looks beautiful to be honest, but the performance is really poor at times. 
  Stuttering and freezes are common-place, even during the cutscenes and the menus!  I've never 
  experienced such long wait times between actions in a fifa game before. Every. Action. Is. So.
  Slowwww. It kills the experience.

+Green screen glitch - between animations in the career mode, the screen normally flickers to a 
  bright green before playing the next scene, giving the illusion the graphics driver is dying.

+Crowds - I've seen static actors in the crowds and cutscenes before games that really ruin the 
  immersion. Maybe a small issue to you, but it's like something from the early 2000's that is just ugly 
  to look at and something we should definitely be passed by now.

+Duplicate players - now this is one of the worst problems for me. As somebody that occasionally 
  updates squads and transfers manually, to keep teams current after the squad updates have ceased, 
  this is a real pain and another really glaring immersion breaker. To explain, when transferring a 
  player via update squads menu on the home menu, the transferred player ends up in both teams 
  when you check the team sheets. They then show up in both teams if you were to play head to 
  head in Kick-off mode AND, they still persist for both teams in Career Mode! How can this happen 
  EA? I've never experienced this before and it's such an important and basic element within the 
  game. How have you ♥♥♥♥♥♥ this up?

+Ridiculous goalkeeper ability and scripting - maybe this is up to interpretation, but for me, even in 
  career mode it seems that there are some games that you're just not meant to win because the 
  game has said so. Ridiculous saves by low level keepers and hitting the post several times in a row 
  with an open goal happens more often than I deem realistic, all so an opponent can get the result 
  and ruin your career mode run. Last minute goals too are infuriating. 

+Defending. Or rather, the lack of. Again - EA do it every year, so I don't know why I'm surprised. AI 
  opponents are so much better this year to be fair, but that just makes it so much more infuriating 
  when your own defenders have not even heard of man-marking. There's no options for it in the 
  team management and using the bumpers is effectively useless as it rarely controls somebody 
  helpful. Then tackling seems to have been removed from the game. No directionality to tackles so 
  even if the player is next to the ball, you press tackle and he sticks a leg out at the air and misses 
 everything. Goal conceded.

+Through balls are crap now - That's it, they just don't really work, same with driven shots and 
  crosses actually. It does encourage clever movement but the game is not quite capable of the 
  required intelligence yet.

+UI is hideous and so unintuitive - All UI's and in-game menus have been streamlined so much that 
  they have no flavour, no nostalgia value. Ugly schemes and nothing but ads for FC27, FUT and other 
  in-game purchases fill the spaces. Career mode UI is also the most boring they've made and don't 
  do anything to encourage the engagement with the rest of the features.  

+Career mode news articles make no sense - For example, I played against PSG as Spurs and a
  news article after the game mentioned that Spurs couldn't get past Kinsky (my keeper), after the 
  game ended 0-0. What?

+Shooting has been nerfed all-round - Maybe it's preference. I do like the realism sometimes but it 
  takes away the fun of scoring a screamer every now and then.

+Transfer negotiations are uneventful - You can make like 50 different offers for the same player 
  during this minigame if you change the fee by small enough increments each time. Just gets a bit 
  silly really. And that's on strict settings. It's also just a boring thing to sit through. There must be 
  better than this, it hasn't changed in like 7 years now.

+Still not enough customisation for your teams in career mode - Let me create kits for a new season, 
  choose sponsors etc. Give me stuff that makes a new season an interesting restart. Even Fifa 09 had 
  sponsors, granted it didn't mean much but build on the feature instead of removing them and then 
  drip-feeding half-arsed content 15 years later that's worse than what we have had already.

+Hideous and unintuitive Tactics system - Why can't I manually move players around anymore? Let 
  me set up a formation that's my creation. I personally hate the Team management screen this year. 
  Doesn't make sense to me at all. And navigation between panels is awful. I like the player-roles to 
  an extent, and maybe it'll take some more getting used to, but the players don't seem to impact the 
  game regardless of my choices. Attackers don't make runs and again defenders don't track runners, 
  so the team management page just becomes a very ugly waste of time. Did I mention the UI is 
  hideous?

+Pace problems - in 2026, we're still having issues with mismatched pace. Why is my winger getting 
  outpaced by the opposition's centre-back 90% of the time? I may have the ball, but it's too easy for 
  them to catch-up. It's like 'rubber-banding' in NFS or Forza. Infuriating every time and makes 
  counter-attacking so much less rewarding, unrealistically so in my opinion.

I'll probably think of lots more issues I have with the game after I've posted this. I'm just bored of the same crap every year and I can't help but hope for better because there's nothing else to satisfy my craving for the sport I love. Do better EA. Don't buy any more FC games people, don't make my mistakes.
